quarterly_data.signal: The EMA's CHMP recommended EU approval (positive opinion, 29 June 2026) of AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo's Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan) as monotherapy for the 1st-line treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer who are not candidates for PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor therapy, based on the TROPION-Breast02 Phase III trial. EVP Susan Galbraith: today only 15% of patients with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer survive beyond five years. The company said that, if approved, Datroway has the potential to be the first TROP2-directed ADC in the EU with a demonstrated overall survival benefit as 1st-line treatment (company claim).
